title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Karuppu reveals Aishwarya's plight after her parents reject her. A remorseful Sethupathi objects to Mohana letting Aishwarya inside, while Chellapandi regrets doubting Tamizhselvi.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Saranya confronts Pooja and Aadhavan for deceiving Karikalan. When Kamala exposes their affair, a furious Karikalan slaps Arjun and Saranya, throwing Pooja out.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Swetha and Mayuri reject Vennila's gifts and refuse to turn against Kanmani. Kanmani finalises share deals as investors sign agreements to join her business.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Karthikeyan secretly arranges Abhi's lehenga on rent. Murugan struggles to arrange non-vegetarian food for the reception without revealing Lakshmi's mess identity.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sakthivel is moved to tears while holding Palanivel's daughter for the first time. Pandian hosts Muthuvel's family for lunch as Gandhimathi appeals for peace between the families.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Meena, Rohini, and Shruthi unite their businesses to launch an event management company. While Vijaya worries about Manoj and Ravi's earnings, Manoj mocks the women's new venture.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Sandhya has Vetri arrested for leaking their video, leaving Sudar worried. Abinaya trusts Vetri's innocence, comforts Sudar, and helps free him to catch the real culprit.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Thennavan plans to elope with Senthamizh to prevent her forced marriage. Poongodi and Thenmozhi prepare chicken biryani to thank Mayandi for buying the home appliances.
